title: command (hub -> agent)
description: An instruction for the agent. The envelope id is the command id and idempotency key: an agent that sees the same id twice (reconnect replay) must not execute twice but must re-send its latest command_result. Every command gets at least one command_result (status accepted within intervals.command_ack_timeout_seconds, then a terminal status). Commands are executed concurrently unless they touch the same instance_id / engine_process_id, in which case they run in arrival order.

timeout_seconds.description: Agent aborts and reports failed(code=timeout) after this; the hub independently marks the row timed_out at expires_at.

swap_operation_id.description: Swap this command belongs to (for log correlation only).

LoadModelArgs.description: Make instance_id serve model on devices. Steps on the agent: ensure cache (download missing files from source, verify sha256, refuse pickle unless allow_pickle), ensure engine artifact, start process (or load into engine_process_id for router mode), wait for health, report succeeded with the port. Result: {"instance_id","port","pid","engine_process_id","served_model_name","ready_at","load_seconds","vram_bytes_used"} (+ "distributed_rank" when launch.distributed is set). Cross-node pipeline parallel: send one load_model per node of the group, same instance_id, each with its own devices and launch.distributed.rank (common.json DistributedSpec); workers (rank > 0) are ready when their stage process is up, the head when its HTTP health passes.

port.description: 0 = agent picks a free port in engine.port_range and returns it in the result.

engine_process_id.description: Router mode: load into this already running engine process (start_engine first). Null = dedicated process.

draft_model.description: Speculative decoding draft model files, when launch.spec_decoding.method = draft_model.

UnloadModelArgs.description: Stop serving an instance. Unless force, the agent first drains (same as drain_instance) and fails with drain_timeout if sessions remain after drain_timeout_seconds. Router mode: unload the model from the router; dedicated: SIGTERM then SIGKILL after kill_grace_seconds. Result: {"instance_id","drained":bool,"active_at_unload":int,"freed_vram_bytes"}.

stop_engine_if_empty.description: Router mode: also stop the engine process when this was its last model.

DrainInstanceArgs.description: Stop accepting new requests at the agent proxy for this instance (503 with Retry-After for new connections; the API layer has already removed it from routing) and wait until active+waiting sessions reach zero or the timeout passes. Emits drain_progress events every 5 s. Result: {"instance_id","drained":bool,"active_sessions","waiting_sessions","elapsed_seconds"}. succeeded even if timed out when wait_for_zero=false; failed(code=drain_timeout) otherwise.

resume.description: True = cancel a drain and accept traffic again (rollback path).

StartEngineArgs.description: Start a shared engine process without a model (llama.cpp router mode, or a custom engine that loads models through its own API). launch.distributed is honoured as for load_model. Result: {"engine_process_id","port","pid"}.

RestartInstanceArgs.description: drain -> unload -> load with the same spec the agent already holds for the instance (the agent keeps the last LoadModelArgs per instance on disk). Result as load_model.

PrefetchModelArgs.description: Download files into the cache without loading. Emits cache_changed events with progress. Result: {"model_version_id","files":[{"model_file_id","local_path","size_bytes","sha256_verified"}],"bytes_downloaded","seconds"}.

EvictCacheArgs.description: Delete cached files. Exactly one selector. Files used by a running instance are never deleted (failed, code=cache_in_use) unless force. Result: {"evicted":[model_file_id],"freed_bytes"}.

unpinned_older_than_seconds.description: LRU sweep: evict unpinned items whose last_used_at is older than this.

target_free_bytes.description: LRU sweep until at least this many bytes are free.

unpin.description: Only clear the pinned flag; do not delete.

RunBenchmarkArgs.description: Run a load test from the node against a local instance (through 127.0.0.1:port, bypassing the proxy). Emits benchmark_progress events per concurrency level. Result: benchmark_runs.results shape plus best_concurrency, slo_met, recommendation.

auto_tune.description: When set the agent also sweeps these launch-flag variants (restarting the instance between variants) and recommends the best one. Only allowed on instances with no live traffic.

UpdateConfigArgs.description: Change agent runtime settings without restart. Same keys as config_push.settings; only present keys change.

RotateCertArgs.description: Agent generates a fresh key pair and returns a CSR in the result ({"csr_pem"}). The hub signs it and follows with install_cert. The old cert stays valid until install_cert succeeds.

InstallCertArgs.description: Install the signed certificate matching the key from rotate_cert, then reconnect the hub socket with it (the hub expects a new hello within 30 s). Result: {"fingerprint_sha256","not_after"}.

CancelArgs.description: Cancel a running command (download, benchmark, drain wait, scan_path, hash_files). The target reports failed(code=cancelled). Result: {"cancelled":bool}.

ScanPathArgs.description: List model candidates under a path on the node's disk (added 2026-11-17, agent >= 1.1.0). Read-only: nothing is written, hashed or moved. Recognises Ollama stores (manifests/ + blobs/ -> kind ollama_blob, sha256 from the manifest digest), LM Studio (~/.lmstudio[/models], incl. .internal/bundled-models -> lmstudio), Hugging Face caches (models--org--name/snapshots/<rev> -> hf_cache), MLX directories (mlx_dir) and plain GGUF files / safetensors / pickle directories (plain). `~` and `~/...` are expanded to the agent user's home. Cancellable. Result: ScanPathResult. Errors: invalid_args (relative path), path_not_found, permission_denied.

path.description: Absolute path (a file or a directory), or `~` / `~/...`.

max_entries.description: Stop after visiting this many directory entries (result.truncated = true).

read_metadata.description: Read GGUF headers and config.json for suggestions (architecture, context size, quantization).

path.description: The expanded absolute path that was scanned.

ScanCandidate.description: One importable model (same shape as admin.yaml LocalScanCandidate plus absolute paths and raw metadata). A diffusers pipeline (model_index.json at the root) is one candidate with every component file. The agent fills suggested.family/type with the control plane's detection rules; the control plane completes what is still null.

path.description: Candidate root: a file (single GGUF, Ollama blob) or a directory.
Relative to the candidate root, '/'-separated (file name for single files / blobs; component/file for diffusers pipelines).

absolute_path.description: Real path on the node (symlinks resolved) — use as ModelSource local_path.

sha256.description: Known without hashing (Ollama digest); otherwise null — use hash_files.

suggested.description: Hints: name, family, type, quantization (GGUF file type, name, or config.json quantization_config: FP8, AWQ, GPTQ, ...), context_size (also from text_config), parameter_count, architecture, size_label, display_name, plus layout-specific keys ollama_name, lmstudio_name, publisher, repo_id, revision, pipeline_class (diffusers). null = unknown.

metadata.description: Raw GGUF header keys (general.*, <arch>.context_length, block_count, ...) or a config.json subset.

HashFilesArgs.description: sha256 of files on the node's disk (added 2026-11-17, agent >= 1.1.0). Streams progress as command_result running frames (progress_pct by bytes, progress_message "<done>/<n> files") at most every progress_interval_seconds. Files are hashed one at a time; a file that cannot be read gets a per-file error and does not fail the command. Cancellable. Result: HashFilesResult.

root.description: When set, paths are relative to root and must resolve inside it (`..` escapes -> per-file invalid_args). `~` expanded.

HashFilesResult.description: command_result.result of hash_files. hashes holds only the files that succeeded (key = the path as sent).

StartSshInstanceArgs.description: Run an SSH-accessible GPU container (added 2026-11-17, agent >= 1.1.0; needs a container runtime, hello.capabilities.container_runtime). The agent writes authorized_keys to <state_dir>/ssh/<id>/authorized_keys (mounted read-only at /etc/gpudeck/authorized_keys, also passed as env PUBLIC_KEY / PUBLIC_KEY_FILE / USER_NAME for linuxserver-style images), runs `image` with the devices attached (NVIDIA --gpus device=<idx>, AMD /dev/kfd + /dev/dri/renderD*, Apple: no GPU passthrough in containers) and the limits applied, publishes container_port on 127.0.0.1 only, and exposes it through its own TCP forwarder on bind_address:ssh_port (protocol.md §8). Idempotent per ssh_instance_id: a running instance is reported, not restarted. Result: SshInstanceResult. Errors: no_container_runtime, image_pull_failed, port_in_use, engine_start_failed, health_timeout, invalid_args.

name.description: Display name; the container is always named gpudeck-ssh-<ssh_instance_id>.

image.description: Container image running sshd (see protocol.md §8 image contract).

devices.description: GPUs to attach; a DeviceAssignment.slice sets that device's VRAM / compute limit.

ssh_port.description: Host port of the agent's forwarder; 0 = first free port in the agent's ssh_port_range (default 2200-2299).

container_port.description: Port sshd listens on inside the container (default image ghcr.io/sur950/gpu-deck-ssh: 2222).

bind_address.description: IP the forwarder listens on. Null = the agent's ssh_bind setting, else the node's advertised proxy address, else 0.0.0.0.

allowed_source_cidrs.description: Client CIDRs accepted by the forwarder; empty = any (the node firewall still applies).

ttl_seconds.description: Agent stops the instance this long after start (the hub enforces TTL too).

SshInstanceLimits.description: Resource limits. vram_bytes / compute_pct apply to every attached device without its own slice: NVIDIA via CUDA MPS env (CUDA_MPS_PINNED_DEVICE_MEM_LIMIT, CUDA_MPS_ACTIVE_THREAD_PERCENTAGE; enforced only when the node runs the MPS daemon), AMD via GPUDECK_DEVICE_CORES / HSA env hints; always exported as GPUDECK_VRAM_LIMIT_BYTES / GPUDECK_COMPUTE_PCT. cpu/memory/shm/pids are enforced by the container runtime.

SshVolume.description: volume = named container volume gpudeck-ssh-<ssh_instance_id>-<source> (removed on stop unless keep); bind = host path, only under the agent cache_dir (forced read-only) or a root in the agent's ssh_bind_roots setting; tmpfs = memory-backed scratch.

source.description: volume: name suffix [a-z0-9_.-]; bind: absolute host path; tmpfs: ignored.

keep.description: volume only: keep the named volume when the instance stops.

SshInstanceResult.description: command_result.result of start_ssh_instance. Connect with `ssh -p <host_port> <ssh_user>@<host_address>` and verify the host key against host_key_fingerprint (OpenSSH `SHA256:<base64>` form).

host_address.description: Address the forwarder listens on (the node's private address when bound to 0.0.0.0).

gpu_attached.description: False when the runtime cannot pass the GPU through (Apple, no NVIDIA toolkit).

StopSshInstanceArgs.description: Stop the forwarder (open sessions are cut), stop and remove the container, remove non-kept volumes and the authorized_keys file. Idempotent: an unknown id succeeds with stopped=false. Result: {"ssh_instance_id","stopped":bool,"container_removed":bool,"volumes_removed":[name]}.

force.description: SIGKILL immediately instead of SIGTERM + kill_grace_seconds.

remove_volumes.description: False = keep every named volume regardless of SshVolume.keep.

StageUpdateArgs.description: Download an agent release binary in the background and stage it (protocol.md §14; capability-gated: only agents listing stage_update in hello.capabilities.commands get it). The agent verifies the manifest signature with a pinned release key, takes binary_sha256 for its own target from it, checks free disk space, downloads GET <hub_url>/agent/v1/updates/<version>/<target> from the hub it joined (never another host; header X-GPUDeck-Update-Token: download_token) over the pinned hub connection, verifies the sha256, checks that the binary runs (`version`), and keeps it in <state_dir>/update/staged/<version>/. The running binary is never touched. Result: {"staged_version","sha256","size_bytes","staged_at"}. Errors: update_unsupported, signature_invalid, insufficient_disk, artifact_download_failed, artifact_checksum_mismatch.

target.description: Must be the agent's own target triple.

download_token.description: Single-purpose token for the hub download (bound to this node, version and target; short-lived).

ApplyUpdateArgs.description: Swap the running agent for the staged version with no model downtime (protocol.md §14): re-verify the staged binary (signature + sha256), atomic swap keeping the previous binary, restart the agent service, re-adopt running engines, health check (the new agent must reconnect to the hub within health_timeout_seconds), else roll back to the previous binary. Progress arrives as event(agent_update) phases; the result is sent by the agent that runs after the restart (succeeded) or after a rollback (failed with code rolled_back). Errors: update_unsupported, not_staged, signature_invalid, update_in_progress, rolled_back.
